t: A2 stainless steel provides ultimate corrosion resistance in materials such as green oak. Ideal for fixing to softwoods, hardwood (pre-drilled), chipboard, MDF and plastic. 40° deep single thread provides secure fixing with high pull-out resistance. Double countersunk for reduced head shear. Fully threaded. Sharp point only.
b: 40° Thread for Secure Fixing & High Pull-Out Resistance
